product_overview: GymTracker is a modern fitness tracking application designed to assist users in logging workouts, managing routines, and improving performance with AI-powered coaching. It provides users with a seamless experience to track progress, receive personalized tips, and stay motivated through an intuitive interface.
core_goals: Enable users to effectively log workouts with detailed exercise tracking including sets, reps, and weights.
Provide AI-driven personalized coaching and feedback to enhance user fitness performance.
Offer comprehensive routine management with categorized exercises and user-customizable plans.
Display clear, accessible progress data including workout history and muscle groups worked.
Ensure a smooth, responsive user experience on both desktop and mobile devices.
Integrate a workout timer to support session pacing and rest periods.
key_features: Dashboard displaying daily routine suggestions and calendar status with AI integration.
Workout Tracking supporting both standard manual logging and AI-assisted logging modes.
AI Coach providing daily fitness tips, post-workout feedback, and interactive chat for personalized advice.
Routine Management system for creating, retrieving, and organizing workout routines and exercises.
User History and Profile pages for reviewing past workout data and managing personal settings.
Integrated Workout Timer with start, stop, and reset controls to manage workout pacing and rest intervals.
user_flow_summary: Users begin at the Dashboard viewing their daily workout routine or schedule.
They select a workout routine from predefined categories like Chest, Back, Legs, and Arms.
Users proceed to execute the workout either in Standard mode (manual logging) or AI-assisted mode where the AI helps log exercises and gather feedback.
Upon workout completion, users receive a summary featuring duration, calories burned estimate, and AI-generated intensity feedback.
Users can browse their workout history and view progress metrics such as weight changes and muscle groups trained.
Throughout the process, the AI coach offers daily tips and engages in chat for interactive fitness guidance.
validation_criteria: All workout data is accurately recorded, stored, and retrievable from the database without loss or corruption.
AI components (daily tips, post-workout analysis, feedback, chat) respond reliably within acceptable latency, supporting streaming outputs.
The UI is fully responsive, tested on various devices and resolutions, maintaining usability on mobile and desktop.
Routines and exercises load correctly and users can select, complete, and modify their workout sessions without errors.
Timer functions correctly with precise start, stop, and reset operations during workout sessions.
User profile and historical data views update correctly and reflect the latest logged workouts and progress.
